statement: Moving thin-tail minimal-circuit theorem IR.1. For every positive sequence eta_K with K eta_K tending to infinity, every sufficiently large power N=2^K has a support-minimal unequal-cardinality equal-product relation of distinct integers entirely inside (N^(1-eta_K),N]. Consequently every hard lower-tail threshold whose deletion cost is o(N), every finite union of nested such thresholds, and every unaltered independent rounding q_N(n)<=g_N w_N(n) with g_N=o(log N) fails in its stated universal or probability-one form.
closes: the complete moving hard-threshold class with o(N) lower-tail deletion
probability-one coverage by affordable independent proportional rounding without alteration
dependency_gaps: IR.1 does not lower-bound the full integral transversal number; each constructed circuit is hit by one deletion.
M786I-05 needs an arithmetic dependency-compression/alteration theorem with loss g(N)=o(log N).
M786I-06 needs a noncircular largest-prime/cofactor owner and an all-N congestion bound g(N)=o(log N).
M786I-12 needs a bounded recursive residue-token potential and, separately, a stabilization plus zero-upper-density theorem for infinite coherence.
The finite integral density-one and infinite natural-density assertions remain open and no closure of original Erdos 786 is claimed.
Independent reconstruction, dependency checking, statement matching, and novelty review have not begun and must be done by a non-author.

supporting_results.rough_host: After a suitable slow smooth/rough split and square-large-prime deletion, every residual integer has a nonempty squarefree active-prime set of size at most L.
supporting_results.active_incidence: Every residual product relation balances each active-prime incidence and therefore the sum of active degrees across the shores.
supporting_results.rank_no_go: Global exponent rank alone cannot control integral hitting: a rank-one powers-of-two family has arbitrarily large transversal lower bound on that subinstance.
supporting_results.fixed_signature_no_go: Any fixed finite valuation signature has a zero cell containing a balanced-padded minimal circuit when all construction primes are chosen outside the controlled set.

evidence_classification.scope: standalone all-parameter obstruction to specified rounding mechanisms only
evidence_classification.machine_reproduced: verify_integral_rounding_kills.py checks exact instantiated identities, thin-tail inequalities, and small support minimality; the universal proof is symbolic
